shifted_value.meaning: TokenId.unwrap(self) >> (64 + legIndex*48 + 36), the shifted leg segment value before masking

stored_width.meaning: the stored 12-bit width field of the leg segment, occupying bits [36:48) of the 48-bit leg segment

returned_width.meaning: the width value returned by width()

upper_bits_present.meaning: the shifted value contains nonzero upper bits from higher-indexed legs

assumptions: The TokenId is a multi-leg position whose shifted leg segment contains nonzero upper bits from higher-indexed legs.
The stored width field occupies bits [36:48) of the 48-bit leg segment, so it is a 12-bit value below 4096.
The returned width is the value produced by width() for the selected leg.

unresolved.description: The report does not give a numeric expression defining stored_width in terms of shifted_value (only the qualitative mask/modulo relation); the relation is stated at the value level instead.

limitations: Only the direct wrong-width impact i_wrong_width_value is formalized; i_wrong_tick_range, i_premium_collateral_errors and i_premium_loss_example are deferred to future claims.
The concrete example value 0x10000000A and the 99% premium reduction are illustrative and not used as formal constants.
The exact legIndex and TokenId value that trigger the wrong width are not specified.
No concrete on-chain transaction or observed incident is provided.
